title: 第二十五章 通灵秘境第二十六章 白虎跃涧
content_zh:
不过紫云道人应该也没有直接把他们锁在秘境里，封个十年的打算。
因为当四个青衣负剑的少年，赶着秘境开启的时辰，抵达秘境封印时，便发现他们并不是唯一一批来‘除魔’的。
还有四拨人也先后到来，大概都是紫云真人找来的。
那群披麻戴孝的最为夸张，早早到了，竟还在秘境洞穴外摆了个灵堂烧纸，孝服底下全甲胄在身，一副上战场的模样，恶狠狠盯着他们，看这来路也最明白。
正是剩下的史家人，三男一女，有老有少，男的都是神罡的霸体，魔宫的外丹，藩军的将校，使刀弄枪的，女的稍差一筹，只外服筑基丹，也提着根八瓣紫金锤，显然有炼体功法傍身的。
还有一拨和史家人凑在一起的，六个修士，瞧着是些散修杂修武修，也都是些金丹境神罡体的，看来都是史家这些年来，结交的江湖朋友，供奉亲卫，今儿也是来助拳报仇的。
第三拨人的路数也很好辨认。
当先的是个锦衣华服，锦帕遮面的少爷，身上宝光十色，玉璧金牌，不知带了多少防身保命的法宝，胯下骑一匹金睛青角麒麟兽，瞧着已然生出灵智，结了灵丹，云缠雾绕，足下生莲，大概也快化形了。
而跟在麒麟少爷身后，是一黑一白，两匹神驹，马鞍上乘着两个轻纱薄裙，似透非透，几乎不着寸缕的姬妾，一个环抱琵琶，一个竖吹玉箫，一路上都在那吹奏弹唱，提供背景音乐，显然是专门跟着伺候少爷的。
再往后，又是三个骑虎豹的供奉法师，四个饲金雕的霸体武卫，最后头还有俩个人犬，带十八条狗，浩浩荡荡一大群人兽，整得和马戏团似得。
这排场，这仪仗，猜都不用猜，摆明了是魔宫的正统，三垣的嫡传了。
大概那当先的少爷，是什么藩国宗室的王侯，在金銮紫禁中呆得久了，鲍参翅肚吃得厌烦了，便出来微服私访，游山玩水，呼吸一点新鲜空气吧。
至于第四拨，则是四个大白天还披黑衣，戴斗笠，把脸遮的严严实实的江湖中人，瞧着和反派杀手似的，但此情此景，反倒他们稍显正常一点呢。
看这架势，燕子洞众人反倒是放心了。
也是呵，修行中人，搞什么磨磨唧唧，阴谋诡计的，有仇必报不隔夜好么。
你看看你看看，这不就凑齐了人手，大概是叫他们进了秘境，便做一场，把恩怨了结么。
做就做喽。
于是还是老样子，岳鹏当先，周凤断后，四人鱼贯而入，顶着周围众人或仇恨，或忌惮，或好奇的目光，当先解开封印，进了通灵秘境。
铁蛋背着剑，跟在岳鹏身后，来回扫着洞天中的地势。
嗯……就是个洞……

好吧，洞天洞天，先洞后天，都是要从山洞隧道里通过去，走到头了，才能柳暗花明又一村，别有一番天地在眼前的。
这其中是什么原理，修行中人也没几个说的清的，毕竟有些人肉眼凡胎，即使身入仙境也不自知，有的地方妖魔盘踞，进得去出不来，还有的人不巧天生是路痴，在秘境洞口转来转去，不得其门而入，晃悠好久都是常有之事。实在也很难总结出穿越洞天的道理来。
不过好在梁州城外这处秘境，由于是妖潮爆发的源头，当年被征西大军扫荡，已经镇压多年，打通过好多次了。因此洞窟地面上，石壁间，都布置有引路的黄符赤线，只要凝聚目力，跟着黑暗中的路引灵踪，自然不会走错。
“师兄，不如在这埋伏一波？”
铁蛋一边走，一边四处张望，很快注意到身后有几条岔道，不知通向何处，或许可以伏击，便拉着岳鹏建议。
岳鹏却摇头，
“不要动手，现在我借不着星力，而且魔宫那少爷手下有个供奉，端的厉害，一路拿神识锁着我，这种冷僻法门，通常没人炼的，恐怕对方手里是有飞剑一类的法宝，切勿耽搁，小心戒备。”
神识锁定？元神之法？
御剑术这一类驾驭法宝的秘籍，有个必要条件，就是得通过神识锁定，给法宝提供明确的攻击目标和导航指引。
因此元神法也是大派不外传的秘术，哪怕一般人机缘巧合，或者家里有矿，得了厉害无比的飞剑法宝，和御物之法，但若没有这神识锁定的秘法，依然派不上多少用场，只能在视距范围内砸人，那还不如弓弩利索呢。
如果是在开阔地形也就罢了，怎么这黑灯瞎火的石洞山道之内，到处还都是符箓禁制干扰，居然有人能一直神识锁定岳师兄？
魔宫果然厉害，底蕴深厚，不可小觑。
于是铁蛋也沉默下来，小心戒备，暗暗把魔宫修士的优先级提了几个顺位，打起来先杀了再说。
很快抵达洞穴尽头，众人一看出入口处的安排也明白了。
原来这洞窟居然有五条隧道，都通往秘境另一侧，每条隧道以青铜大门闭锁，只能自人间一侧开启。
而门前还有石匣，内置五枚铁符，就是等会儿要带到封神台上，用以替换旧符，维护镇魔台妖魔封印的道具，不过倒也不需全部换上，只要有一枚替换即可了。
想来这里安排分成五路，也是防备着被妖魔堵门狙击，而只要有一枚铁符能抵达封魔台，就可以确保大妖封印至少十年的安稳了。
岳鹏把玉佩一招，射出一道青光，一道青铜大门上的符印便被激活，隆隆声中打开门来。
铁蛋瞧瞧那青铜大门另一层的洞口，又看看扑朔扑朔从门上落下的积灰。
“师兄，其他门你能打开么？”
content_en:
However, Taoist Ziyun probably had no intention of directly locking them in the secret realm for ten years.
Because when the four young men in green clothes and carrying swords arrived at the seal of the secret realm in time for the opening of the secret realm, they discovered that they were not the only ones who came to 'eliminate demons'.
Four groups of people also arrived one after another, probably all brought by Master Ziyun.
The most exaggerated group was those wearing hemp and mourning. They arrived early and even set up a mourning hall outside the secret cave to burn paper. They were wearing full armor under their mourning clothes and looked like they were on the battlefield. They stared at them fiercely, knowing where they were coming from.
It is the remaining Shi family members, three men and one woman, both old and young. The men are all Shen Gang's tyrants, the magic palace's external elixirs, and the generals of the vassal army, who can use swords and guns. The women are slightly inferior. They only wear foundation building elixirs and carry an eight-petal purple gold hammer. They obviously have body-refining skills.
There was also a group of six monks who gathered with the Shi family. They looked like casual practitioners and mixed martial arts cultivators, and they were all Jindan realm divine gang body practitioners. It seemed that they were all the friends the Shi family had made over the years and were serving as personal guards. Today they also came to help avenge themselves.
The number of the third group of people is also easy to identify.
The leader was a young man in brocade clothes and a brocade handkerchief covering his face. His body was full of treasures, and he had a jade gold medal. He had brought countless magic weapons for self-defense and life-saving. He was riding a golden-eyed and green-horned unicorn beast on his crotch. He looked like he was already born with spiritual wisdom, formed a spiritual elixir, wrapped in clouds and mist, and had lotuses growing under his feet. He was probably about to transform.
Behind Young Master Qilin were two divine horses, one black and one white. On the saddles were riding two thin gauze skirts, which seemed to be transparent but not completely naked. One of them hugged the pipa, and the other played the jade flute. They were playing and singing along the way, providing background music. They were obviously dedicated to serving the young master.
After that, there were three worship mages riding tigers and leopards, four domineering military guards riding golden eagles, and finally there were two human dogs and eighteen dogs, forming a huge group of humans and beasts, which looked like a circus.
This pomp and ceremony, there is no need to guess, it is clear that it is the orthodoxy of the Demon Palace, the direct descendant of Miyuan.
Probably the young master in charge was a prince of some vassal clan. He had stayed in the Jinluan Forbidden City for a long time and got tired of eating abalone, ginseng, wings and tripe, so he came out incognito for a private visit, sightseeing in the mountains and rivers, and breathing some fresh air.
As for the fourth group, there are four people from the world who are still wearing black clothes and hats in broad daylight, covering their faces tightly. They look like villains and killers, but in this situation, they are a little bit normal.
Seeing this posture, everyone in Yanzidong felt relieved.
That's right. Those who are cultivators, those who engage in gossiping and scheming, must avenge themselves overnight, okay?
Look at it, look at it, isn't it just that we have gathered people together, probably asked them to enter the secret realm, and have a show to settle their grudges.
Just do it.
So it was the same as before, Yue Peng took the lead, Zhou Fengduan came after, and the four of them filed in. Against the hatred, fear, or curiosity of everyone around them, they were the first to unlock the seal and enter the secret realm of psychics.
Tiedan carried his sword on his back and followed Yue Peng, scanning the terrain in the cave sky back and forth.
Well...it's just a hole...
Well, caves and caves, first the cave and then the next, you have to pass through the cave tunnel, and when you reach the end, you can see another village with dark flowers and dark flowers, and a different world is in front of you.
What is the principle behind this, few practitioners can explain it clearly. After all, some people are mortal with the naked eye and do not know it even if they enter the fairyland. In some places, demons are entrenched and they can enter but cannot get out. Some people are born to be road fools by chance, wandering around the entrance of the secret cave without being able to enter, and it is common for them to wander around for a long time. It is actually difficult to sum up the reason for traveling through the cave.
Fortunately, this secret area outside Liangzhou City was the source of the demon tide. It was swept away by the army that conquered the west. It has been suppressed for many years and has been broken through many times. Therefore, on the cave floor and between the stone walls, there are yellow talisman and red lines that lead the way.Concentrate your eyesight and follow the path in the darkness, and you will naturally not go wrong.
"Senior brother, why don't we set an ambush here?"
Tiedan looked around as he walked, and soon noticed a few forks behind him. He didn't know where they led. Maybe they could be ambushed, so he pulled Yue Peng to suggest it.
Yue Peng shook his head,
"Don't do it. I can't borrow star power now, and the young master in the Demon Palace has a priest who is very powerful. He locked me with his spiritual consciousness all the way. This kind of remote method is usually not practiced by anyone. I'm afraid the opponent has magic weapons like flying swords in his hands. Don't delay and be careful."
Divine consciousness locked? The method of the soul?
There is a necessary condition for secrets such as sword control to control magic weapons, which is to provide clear attack targets and navigation guidance for the magic weapons through divine consciousness locking.
Therefore, the Yuanshen method is also a secret technique that is not spread among the big sects. Even if ordinary people get the extremely powerful flying sword magic weapon and the method of controlling objects by chance, or have a mine at home, without this secret method locked by the divine consciousness, it is still of little use. They can only hit people within sight range, which is not as good as a crossbow.
If it's in open terrain, that's it. Why is it that in this dark stone cave mountain road, with talismans and restrictions everywhere, someone can actually lock onto Senior Brother Yue with his consciousness?
The Demon Palace is indeed powerful and has a profound foundation that should not be underestimated.
So Tiedan also fell silent, and was on guard, secretly raising the priority of the Demon Palace monks a few places, and killing them first before starting a fight.
Soon they arrived at the end of the cave, and everyone understood the arrangement at the entrance.
It turns out that this cave actually has five tunnels, all leading to the other side of the secret realm. Each tunnel is closed with a bronze door and can only be opened from the human side.
There is also a stone box in front of the door with five iron talismans inside, which will be taken to the Conferring God Platform later to replace the old talismans and maintain the demon seal of the Demon Suppressing Platform. However, it is not necessary to replace them all, as long as one is replaced.
If you want to come here and arrange to be divided into five groups, you are also prepared to be blocked by the demon and sniped. As long as an iron talisman can reach the demon sealing platform, you can ensure the stability of the big demon seal for at least ten years.
Yue Peng moved the jade pendant and shot out a green light. The talisman on the bronze door was activated, and the door opened with a rumble.
Tiedan looked at the opening on the other floor of the bronze door, and then at the dust that had fallen from the door.
"Senior brother, can you open the other doors?"
